title: RAVEL replay comparison tolerances
description: Tolerances for `ravel replay compare`. Integer counts always compare exactly. Floating-point values compare within default_relative. A statistical bound applies only when both seeds are recorded and differ; equal seeds use the deterministic rule. A missing seed makes the quantity not comparable. Ignore pointers must be non-empty. A statistical quantity pointer may be the root pointer. A seed pointer must be non-empty and must not cover a sampled quantity of its document. A statistical row takes effect only when its quantity pointer resolves in both runs and its seed pointer names one integer or one string; otherwise the values under the seed pointer are compared and the row is reported as not comparable. Pointers are JSON pointers into the named output document.

default_relative.description: Relative tolerance for deterministic floating-point values.

ignore.description: Additional values that are record metadata rather than quantities.

statistical.description: Sampled quantities and their declared statistical tolerance.

document.description: Output document path relative to the attempt output directory.

seed_pointer.description: Where each run records its seed; never a pointer that covers a sampled quantity.

uncertainty_pointer.description: Per-run uncertainty at the same position as the value; the bound is n_sigma times their quadrature sum.
